text:
maria: Heads-up, I triggered a regression on AWQ+FP8 serving that causes a bursty OOM pattern during long chats. Root seems to be aggressive eager compaction + mixed-dtype KV cache packing.

maria: Repro steps: run nightly perf-runner with awq-compat profile, sequence=4096, batch=1, enable_fp8=true, compaction=auto. After ~20k tokens the host reports OOM on allocator reflow.

maria: Quick profiling snapshot (allocated bytes over time):
```
Timeline:
0s  -> GPU free: 28 GiB
5s  -> KV grow: +3.6 GiB (fp8->float32 upcasts in hot-path)
12s -> eager-compact triggered: free drops to 2.1 GiB
13s -> OOM on kernel_select (matmul_fused)
```

maria: Noticed allocator churn spikes right before compaction: many tiny frees then a big defrag that flips fragments into unusable holes.

dave: Interesting — are we seeing precision upcasts in the attention KV or in the intermediate activations?

maria: Mainly KV. AWQ stores k/v as int8-like layout; our fp8 path lazily upcasts parts for compatibility with some kernels. Upcast + slab compaction causes cross-chunk fragmentation.

arjun: Could be the eager-compact window size. We recently lowered deferred_free_window to 30ms to reduce tail latency — that might make compaction more frequent.

zoe: Can you paste the allocator metrics and the kernel selection trace? small snippet is fine.

maria: Pasted traces below (trimmed):
```
ALLOC_EVENTS:
[1001] alloc 1.2MiB slab#7
[1002] alloc 2.8MiB slab#8
[1010] free 1.2MiB slab#7
[1012] eager_compact start
[1013] relocate slab#8 -> slab#2 (failed, >frag_thresh)
[1014] fallback kernel_selected: matmul_fallback
[1015] OOM
```
KERNEL_TRACE:
matmul_fused prefer: tensor_core_fp8
matmul_fused fallback: tensor_core_fp16 (upcast path)
```

maria: So flow: fp8 path preferred -> allocator can't place relocated chunks -> fallback to fp16 kernel requiring transient upcasts -> memory spikes -> OOM.

arjun: That matches a hypothesis: compaction is turning many medium-sized runs into relocation attempts that then request temporary staging buffers for upcasts. Staging buffer + relocated live segments exceed headroom.

dave: Two immediate mitigations to test: 1) increase deferred_free_window to 200ms to reduce compactions frequency, 2) disallow fp16 fallback when serving AWQ KV (force either native kernel or block request). Which do we want to try first?

maria: I can run 1) quickly on the repro harness. Will also add a metric for "upcast_staging_bytes" so we can track.

zoe: We should also add a low-cost heuristic in kernel selector: if post-compaction free < safe_headroom and fallback requires upcast staging > X, prefer keeping original kernel or rejecting request with 503 instead of OOM.

arjun: Agreed. We can compute cheap estimate: upcast_staging_est = (#kv_chunks_to_upcast) * per_chunk_upcast_overhead. Add that to allocator headroom check.

maria: Running deferred_free_window=200ms now on one nodepool. I'll post results in ~15 min.

sre-bot: Deploy: changed config deferred_free_window from 30ms -> 200ms on pool-runtime-eawq-1 (maria). Rolling to 3 nodes.

maria: Quick result: with 200ms window, compaction events dropped 78%, and no OOM after 50k tokens. upcast_staging_bytes peaked 1.3GiB vs 4.9GiB before. Latency tail increased ~3ms p99.

dave: Good tradeoff. Next steps:
- arjun: implement headroom check in kernel selector to estimate upcast staging and avoid fallback that causes compaction storms
- zoe: add metric and alert for "upcast_staging_bytes" and compaction rate spikes
- maria: run longer 24h overnight run with window=200ms and batch skew patterns

arjun: I'll prototype estimator: need fast per-layer kv_chunk_count and upcast_factor. Probably a single-vector pass during kernel selection, cheap.

zoe: I'll add dashboard widget and an alert: compaction_rate > 5/min AND upcast_staging_bytes > 2GiB -> paging pager.

maria: Thanks all. If the overnight run looks clean we'll roll window change to canary for production. Also filing a follow-up issue for allocator reflow heuristics (fragment cost model + prefer-localized relocation).

triage-bot: Issue created: RFC #4523 "KV upcast staging headroom estimator and compaction hysteresis" assigned to arjun, zoe, maria.

maria: Added a short checklist in the issue with reproduction artifacts and the profiling snippets. :rocket:
